title: School Founding Year
details: GHS Coimbatore established in a single-room thatch roof hut with 15 students and 1 teacher.

title: High School Roster Status
details: Formally recognized by Tamil Nadu State Education Department as a government High School (Class 6-10).

title: Science Lab Wing Built
details: First brick-and-mortar wing built for laboratory experimentation with basic glassware.

title: Computer Lab Center
details: Inaugurated our first computer laboratory with 15 donated desktops and basic typing tutor sessions.

title: AI Smart Classrooms Setup
details: Installation of the first smart screen boards and tablets for interactive digital learning models.
